C0285.title: Acer Suffers Breach: 160GB of Sensitive Data Leaked in Hacker Attack
C0285.summary: In mid-February 2023, Taiwan-based tech firm Acer was hit by a cyberattack. A hacker using the alias Kernelware claimed to have stolen 160GB of sensitive information, including 655 directories and 2,869 files. Later reporting said Acer confirmed that one of its servers had been breached, with the exposed content mainly involving company sensitive information.
